# PR #3929: Patch: the board says Canceled, Countered and Draw limit, and the turn banner says when a turn was cut short or the AI took it, with effects on or off

Closes #3910

## What changed

The board now says its own words for five moments, with the effects Off or On. The change is client-only (CLAUDE.md rule 7): no engine, wire or crate change.

- **Draw limit.** `drawLimited` joins `NOTICE_EVENTS` with a `drawLimit` notice kind, so `PileNotice` draws "Draw limit" on that seat's Deck pile as it draws "Deck full".
- **Canceled and Countered.** A new `EventTag` component (`apps/web/src/game/EventTag.tsx`) draws "Canceled" while `attackCancelled` plays and "Countered" while `countered` plays.
  - `Card.tsx` renders it inside the card root, which covers the attacker and the viewer's own held hand card.
  - `Board.tsx`'s `Pile` renders it too, so the opponent's countered play shows the word on the graveyard or exile pile it went to.
  - The tag reads only the event type already in the animating map, never a card name or id (R97).
- **Turn banner.** `isTurnEvent` and `bannerText` in `Game.tsx` now know `turnCutShort` and `autopilotEngaged`, and read "Turn cut short" and "The AI takes the turn" (the words the effects layer already used).
- **Styling.** `overflow.css` has the looks and `animations.css` the entrances. The `countered` tag shares the existing 350 ms fade rule, and the Draw-limit tag reuses the Deck-full tag's entrance. `motion.test.ts`'s pinned count for `animations.css` goes from 69 to 70, for the one new scaled duration.
- **Chinese.** `zh-CN.json` gets 已取消, 被反制 and 抽牌上限. "Turn cut short" and "The AI takes the turn" already had entries.
- **Spec.**
  - BUILD's `turnCutShort` row now says "Turn cut short" in both places, as the effect does.
  - New `spec/rulings/R3910000.md`, its paragraph in `spec/pending/3910.md`, and one sentence in §10.10 linking it.
  - I did not run `spec index` or touch `spec/11-rulings.md`.

## How I tested it

- `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh` first, since vitest and typecheck need `apps/web/src/wasm/pkg`.
- Touched test files: `overflow.test.tsx`, the new `event-tags.test.tsx` and `turn-start-bleed.test.tsx` (54 tests) pass after fixing one test of mine (see "Look twice").
- Stylesheet and i18n guards: `src/i18n`, `motion.test.ts`, `surfaces`, `spacing`, `typescale`, `typography`, `palette`, `rootVars`, `animations` and `animation-targets`: 11 files, 132 tests pass.
- Wide pass: `vitest run src/game src/test`: 176 files, 2916 tests pass.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/game apps/web/src/motion.test.ts` print no errors.
- `cargo jackioh spec check`: "2170 rulings, 5525 proofs … ok".
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`: "classify: Internal", no complaint.
- `cargo fmt --check` passes, and `git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire` is empty.
- Mutation check: I temporarily made the banner's standing-view fallback accept `autopilotEngaged` again. "The AI's words do not outlast the entries that play them" failed, and I restored the code.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- **Stale AI banner.** The standing-view fallback ignores `autopilotEngaged`, so only the burst's own entries say "The AI takes the turn". I rejected holding it until the next `turnStarted`: the view's event window spans several actions, and once an R1844000 aura hands the turn back, that would say the AI plays through a human's own actions.
- **Opponent's countered play.** The tag goes on the graveyard or exile pile the event animates, since the opponent's card is not a readable element. I rejected tagging only the viewer's own hand card.
- **Words.** I changed BUILD's row to "Turn cut short" instead of changing the effect to "Turn ended".
- **CSS.** The `countered` tag reuses the 350 ms fade. I rejected a new 450 ms rule, which would have meant a second pinned-count bump.
- **Ruling.** A new R3910000, not an edit to R318, which says "the three overflows".

- A card countered back into a hand shows no tag, because the `hand-<side>` region carries no `data-animating` anywhere. I left that alone, and R3910000 says so.
